# Lexical Form Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](gmeow-LexicalFormType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LexicalFormType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)

The kind of a lexical form — a value, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence; new analytical frameworks may introduce further form types without ontology modification.

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](gmeow-LexicalFormType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
